title: NYSE American Options: November 2026 Pricing Changes
raw_text:
NYSE American Options: November 2026 Pricing Changes
Markets: NYSE AMERICAN OPTIONS; Services: Trading, Post Trade, Market Data
NYSE American Options will amend its fee schedule as follows: The Initiating Participant CUBE rebates will be revised to ($0.105) per contract, from ($0.115) per contract (effective November 2, 2026). Adopt pricing for Binary Return Options (effective October 29, 2026) CUBE Rebates For Single-Leg CUBE, Complex CUBE, and AON CUBE auction executions, the Initiating Participant CUBE rebate will be revised to ($0.105) per contract, from ($0.115) per contract. Per-contract rebate caps will continue to apply (i.e., to the first 5,000 contracts of a Single-Leg CUBE Order and the first 1,000 contracts per leg of a Complex CUBE Order). Binary Return Options Pricing The per-contract rate for electronic transactions in Binary Options will be $0.01 for DOMMs, e-Specialists, Specialists, and NYSE American Options Market Makers. Electronic pricing for all other participants will be the same as for standard options. Binary Return Options executions are excluded from the Market Maker Sliding Scale (Section I.C.), the American Customer Engagement (ACE) Program (Section I.E.), and Marketing Charges. All other standard pricing in the Fee Schedule applies to Binary Options. Please contact rmteam@nyse.com with any questions about these updates.
